name: text-to-video-by-google
title: 让 AI 生成的剪辑准备好发布，无需触摸单个滑块
description: Get AI generated clips ready to post, without touching a single slider. Upload your text prompts (TXT, DOCX, PDF, plain text, up to 10MB), say something like "generate a 10-second video clip of a futuristic city skyline at night", and download 1080p MP4 when it's done. Built for marketers, content creators, educators who move fast and want to create videos without cameras or editing skills.
title_en: Text to Video by Google — Generate Videos from Text Descriptions
